source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

We appreciate the time you have spent on Milestones 1 and 2. Following a detailed review, our editorial team found several issues that we need to address with you directly.

**Instructional text left in the submission:** At the beginning of Milestone 1, there is a note containing direct usage directions ("delete or edit the question in suggesting mode... then paste the comment as your rationale"). This appears to be scaffolding from an AI workflow that was mistakenly not removed.

**Mention of content that does not exist:** Both the document and the manuscript text reference a "book-wide note on the first page," but no such note appears anywhere in the document.

**Submission speed:** Milestone 2, consisting of five full chapters, was delivered in roughly one day. That turnaround does not align with the level of original, in-depth analysis required for this work.

**AI-detection findings:** Independent detection tools flagged the Milestone 2 material within the 75–90% range.

Under your contract, AI-assisted tools may be used on a limited basis for spelling, grammar, research, outlining, translation, and editorial support, as long as the final manuscript represents your own original work and professional judgment. In light of the points above, the material submitted does not appear to satisfy that requirement.

Considering all of these factors, we have decided not to continue with the project. Thank you for your interest in the role and for the effort you contributed, and we wish you all the best moving forward.

Thank you.
